_comment: Obtainium source descriptor for the Pebble app fork (HLDD-004 §2/§4 step Q).
Import into Obtainium via: Add App -> (paste the fork releases URL) OR
Settings -> Import/Export -> Import from JSON (this file, wrapped as an
export uses an `apps` array; a single-app import accepts this object).
GitHub source type; Obtainium polls the fork's Releases and offers an
install when a newer build appears. Release assets are named
versionName is the resolved store version (injected at build time);
versionCode is the nanogiants commit-count metric (§3), used for update
detection so each landed upstream commit produces a higher versionCode.
